mapper.select: select count(*) from md_warehouse where id=#{id} and enabled=1 and deleted=0
select tracking_mode,enabled from md_material where id=#{id} and deleted=0
select id from inv_issue where issue_no=#{issueNo}
mapper.update: update inv_serial set status='ISSUED' where warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} and material_id=#{materialId} and serial_no=#{serialNo} and status='IN_STOCK'
update inv_batch set quantity=quantity-#{quantity} where warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} and material_id=#{materialId} and batch_no=#{batchNo} and quantity>=#{quantity}
mapper.select: select id,quantity,version from inv_balance where warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} and material_id=#{materialId} and deleted=0 for update
mapper.update: update inv_balance set quantity=#{quantity},version=version+1,updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and version=#{version}
mapper.select: select count(*) from inv_issue i join md_material m on m.id=i.material_id where i.deleted=0 and (i.issue_no like #{like} or m.code like #{like} or m.name like #{like})

select cast(i.id as char) id,i.issue_no issueNo,w.name warehouse,m.code materialCode,m.name materialName, i.quantity,i.batch_no batchNo,i.purpose,d.name department,u.display_name requester, i.issued_at issuedAt,i.remark from inv_issue i join md_warehouse w on w.id=i.warehouse_id join md_material m on m.id=i.material_id join sys_department d on d.id=i.department_id join sys_user u on u.id=i.requester_id where i.deleted=0 and (i.issue_no like #{like} or m.code like #{like} or m.name like #{like}) order by i.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select cast(i.id as char) id,i.issue_no issueNo,w.name warehouse,cast(i.warehouse_id as char) warehouseId, m.code materialCode,m.name materialName,m.tracking_mode trackingMode,cast(i.material_id as char) materialId, i.quantity,i.batch_no batchNo,i.serial_numbers_json serialNumbers,i.purpose, d.name department,u.display_name requester,i.issued_at issuedAt,i.remark from inv_issue i join md_warehouse w on w.id=i.warehouse_id join md_material m on m.id=i.material_id join sys_department d on d.id=i.department_id join sys_user u on u.id=i.requester_id where i.id=#{id} and i.deleted=0
